_note: Args used for the Stowe trace test with the trailmap-trace workflow (run after the review, blind; 3 readers, ~3 min, ~200k tokens). Build the groups from trailProposals.json + seed_roster's labels.json: trails with no pieces that are not glades, medium/low proposals, and pieces reported as SPLIT.
resort: Stowe Mountain Resort, Vermont, 2025-26 winter map
legend: Trail difficulty = the color of the drawn trail line (green / blue / black) and the symbol printed with the name (green circle, blue square, black diamond, two black diamonds). Orange lines = freestyle terrain. Thick maroon lines are LIFTS. Yellow dotted lines = ski area boundary. Pink shaded areas = race areas; yellow shaded areas = learning/slow zones; orange triangles = crossover/yield areas; small white circles with a snowflake = snowmaking. A small black square icon with trees = GLADED TERRAIN. Trail names are black capital text on a white halo. Some trails are printed only as a name and symbol on an open slope, with no drawn line.
